description: This file defines API endpoints for managing 'tags' in a FastAPI-based web service. It includes routes for listing all tags and creating a new tag, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM and Pydantic schemas.

classes.name: TagCreateRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the request payload for creating a new tag, including validation for the name field.

methods.name: list[TagResponse] list_tags(db: AsyncSession = Depends())
methods.description: Asynchronous function that retrieves and returns a list of all tags from the database.

methods.name: TagResponse create_tag( payload: TagCreateRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(), _user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Asynchronous function that creates a new tag if it does not already exist, enforcing authentication and input validation.

ctags.name: create_tag
ctags.signature: ( payload: TagCreateRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(), _user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )

ctags.name: name
ctags.pattern: /^    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=64, description="Tag name (unique)")$/
